title: VIDTOOLZ Multi-Agent Authority Contract
authority: This contract defines authority decomposition for the VIDTOOLZ production system. The registry (config/agent-registry.json) remains the home of per-agent doctrine; this file is the home of the role roster, shared contract fields, authority boundaries, disagreement model, approval binding, and build order. Agent identity is the ROLE. Models and machines are execution infrastructure and never agent identity.

owns: escalation of blocked states and unresolved disagreement
prohibited: recording human approval on Mikko's behalf
choosing the side it finds more convincing in a conflict
hermes.doctrine: Hermes may use infrastructure capabilities required to route work, but capability does not confer specialist authority. Hermes is not a super-agent and not specialist #13.

deterministic_first.principle: An agent may never own a check that a deterministic validator can authoritatively make. Agents may interpret validator output or decide next actions when judgment is required.
deterministic_first.rule: These must never be represented as autonomous agents in the registry.

boundaries: Must never convert a creative problem into an infrastructure problem merely because the workflow is blocked.
Selects only among eligible configured routes; cannot invent missing coverage.
If an edit changes the argument, it must become a decision/escalation, not an invisible edit.
QC detects, blocks, explains. It never fixes, regenerates, or chooses aesthetics.

owns: translating an approved music brief into executable music instructions
does_not_own: backend/infrastructure policy outside its granted execution scope
boundaries: Creative may propose mood; Mikko approves final music. Editor retains timeline authority; Sound proposes music changes. Execution only through the authorized music_generation lane; unauthorized fallback is impossible (fail-closed).

does_not_own: factual-support verdicts or Research Result state
episode creative identity or visual concept
boundaries: Story creates immutable Script Builder candidate versions and mandatory Story Revision Review bundles, never approvals. Material argument, thesis, spine, premise, or controversial framing changes require Mikko. Research remains factual authority; Editor remains timeline authority; QC remains independent.

owns: translating approved concept/script into visual coverage
boundaries: Visual concept (Creative) is sharply separated from shot/prompt specification (Visual Planning).
Must not invent or rewrite the argument without escalation.
Deliberately narrow. Built last because the more subjective and cross-domain a role is, the greater the risk it becomes a vague Mikko-replacement or super-agent.
Semantic judgment only over deterministic Research Result V1. Mikko decides controversial editorial risk. Hermes routes; Story owns wording; QC validates.

owns: curating global doctrine proposals, incidents, rejected approaches, provenance references
knowledge_steward.write_gate: Authoritative durable rule/decision writes are human-gated. The registry remains the home of agent doctrine; the brain/memory system remains the home of durable production decisions/learnings. No duplicated storage.

exclusive_decisions: recording of human approval (no agent or Hermes may record it on his behalf)

shared_contract.compatibility: Fields already expressed in the registry under stable names (agent_id, name, role, mission, reports_to, allowed_actions, prohibited_actions, escalation_rules) are preserved unchanged. The fields below are the required contract surface; registered agents must carry them either natively or via this contract's defaults until individually upgraded.

fields.authority_scope: what this role is the single accountable authority for
fields.input_contract: required, validated inputs before the role may act
fields.output_contract: machine-readable shape of the role's outputs
fields.human_gate_type: which Mikko gate (if any) this role's outputs feed
fields.approval_binding: how durable approvals bind to artifact identity (see approval_binding)
fields.decision_refs: references to decisions this role depends on or has made
fields.memory_scope: what this role may persist and where
fields.retry_budget: mechanical retry limits (registry: retry_policy for generation_supervisor)
fields.deadline_priority: scheduling weight used by Hermes routing

approval_binding.principle: Every durable human approval binds to the exact artifact it approves. Generalizes the proven Earth Studio durability mechanism (scripts/earth-studio-promotion-durability.js): artifact path + sha256 + source commit + human-review record + byte comparison. No competing mechanism may be introduced.
approval_binding.stale_rule: An approval whose recorded artifact_sha256 does not match the current artifact bytes is STALE and carries no authority. A detached approval (no hash/commit binding) is INVALID.
approval_binding.verification: verifyApprovalBinding(binding, currentBytes) returns VALID | STALE | INVALID; validators and gates must treat STALE and INVALID identically to no-approval.

routing: if one role owns the decision, route there (RESOLVED_BY_CONTRACT)
if authority still conflicts between specialists, surface both positions (NEEDS_SPECIALIST_REVIEW)
Hermes escalates with both positions and dissent evidence preserved verbatim
Mikko decides when human authority is required (NEEDS_HUMAN_DECISION); unresolvable-without-human becomes BLOCKED only when production cannot proceed at all
invariants: Agents must not silently collapse conflicting judgments into a synthetic answer.
Hermes must never choose the side it finds more convincing.
Dissent evidence is preserved whenever a disagreement leaves NEEDS_SPECIALIST_REVIEW.

lifecycle_authority.canonical: The 14 evidence-gate workflow (scripts/package-run-workflow-map.js GATE_DEFINITIONS) is canonical and governs evidence/promotion.
projections: pipeline-tracker.js (13-stage UI tracker) is a display projection
cockpit dashboards, doctor output, and resume-work views are projections
lifecycle_authority.rule: Operator/UI trackers must never become a competing source of truth. Projection loss must degrade display, never authority.

run_state.invariant: Every active package run has one machine-readable canonical workflow state derived from the 14-gate engine.
run_state.marker: package-run-state.md is an optional local marker (active/parked/superseded) read by package-runs-index.js — it classifies lifecycle, it does not override gate evidence.
run_state.ambiguity: If evidence is incomplete, state is AMBIGUOUS. Guessing is prohibited. Cockpit surfaces must never infer a more confident state than the evidence supports.
run_state.owner: Production Operations owns run-state maintenance; Hermes reads and routes from it.

control_room_contract.extends: The Earth Studio agent-status approach (scripts/earth-studio-agent-status.js) is the pattern; extend it to all agents rather than creating a second control-room model.
questions_answered: Does Mikko need to decide something?

build_order_note: Creative Director is intentionally last: subjective cross-domain roles carry the highest super-agent risk and must not be built until surrounding authority boundaries are proven.
